title: Director, Supply Chain Quality
text:
Are you ready to be part of a company that's not just talking about the future, but actively shaping it? Join The AES Corporation, the largest US-based global power company with a team of 8,300 employees across 12 countries.
 
 
AES has been **ranked #1 by BloombergNEF** in renewable energy sales to corporations in the US and Americas for five consecutive years, providing electricity for **millions of people worldwide.**
 
 
We are proud to foster a strong workplace culture, earning prominent positions in Great Place to Work™ rankings across the markets where we operate. AES was also named one of the World’s Most Ethical Companies for the 13th consecutive year in 2026, highlighting our dedication to integrity, transparency, and responsible business practices.

Our spirit of innovation continues to earn industry recognition. AES is the only seven-time winner of the Edison Electric Institute’s Edison Awards in the twenty-first century, a distinction honoring global leadership in advancing the electric power industry. 
 
If you're ready to be part of a company that's not just adapting to change, but driving it, AES is the place for you. We're not just building a more sustainable future, we're powering it. Apply now and energize your career with a true leader in global energy.

**Job Description Summary**

The Director – Supply Chain Quality will establish and lead the Supply Chain Quality program within the Strategic Sourcing function. Reporting to the Vice President of Strategic Sourcing, this position will be responsible for developing AES strategy and processes to ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of owner-furnished equipment supporting the AES Renewables & Power business. This role will serve as the primary interface between Strategic Sourcing and internal teams such as Engineering, Execution, Operations, and our primary suppliers to proactively manage quality risk, improve supplier performance, and drive continuous improvement throughout the equipment lifecycle.

The ideal candidate will be capable of coordinating and collaborating with multiple teams across AES and take responsibility for ensuring the successful improvement of supplier performance across our equipment pipeline. Prior experience in Supply Chain Quality in renewables, gas and/or power sector strongly preferred.

This position will be ideally based in Louisville, CO. AES provides a flexible working environment, and remote work is possible with approval of location. Travel will also be required (~50%) 
 
**Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and implement the company’s supply chain quality strategy, standards, and governance processes
* Lead supplier qualification, factory audits, manufacturing surveillance, inspections, testing, and corrective action programs for major equipment suppliers.
* Oversee quality assurance activities for solar modules, battery energy storage systems, inverters, transformers, wind equipment, gas turbines, and other critical project components.
* Participate in and support Strategic Sourcing Category Managers with regular supplier meetings, including Quarterly Business Reviews, with quality-related updates and reviews
* Identify and mitigate supplier quality, manufacturing, and reliability risks that could impact project cost, schedule, safety, or operational performance.
* Partner with Engineering, Construction, Procurement, and Operations teams to resolve quality issues and incorporate lessons learned into future sourcing strategies and design/specification practices.
* Manage third-party quality service providers supporting audits, inspections, production monitoring, and testing activities.
* Establish supplier performance metrics and continuous improvement initiatives focused on reliability, delivery performance, and defect reduction.
* Create data-driven systems to track and manage all activities and progress
* Drive root cause analysis, corrective actions, and warranty recovery efforts related to equipment failures and field performance issues.
* Maintain strong vendor relationships and represent the company’s values, quality expectations, and culture in all supplier interactions.
* Other job‑related duties and projects as assigned.

**Skills & Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Engineering degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, or related field preferred; equivalent experience considered
* 10+ years of experience in quality assurance, quality control, supplier quality, manufacturing, or major‑equipment oversight within renewable energy, electrical equipment, EPC, or related industries
* 2+ years managing a team
* Technical knowledge of solar modules, inverters, racking, transformers, HV equipment, wind equipment, and/or battery energy storage systems
* Demonstrated success working to develop consensus from diverse opinions in a highly fluid and sometimes ambiguous multi-cultural environment
* Experience conducting or managing factory audits, FATs, certification testing, and supplier qualification activities
* Proficient with MS Office suite, Quickbase, Power BI and other software systems and analytical tools
* Experience building dashboarding and reporting metrics, and establishing those within a company’s system of record
* Familiarity and willingness to use AI tools and platforms to support work and reporting
* Understanding of and experience with SAP or similar ERP systems
* Quality certifications (ASQ, Six Sigma, ISO Auditor)

AES is an Equal Opportunity Employer who is committed to building strength and delivering long-term sustainability through diversity and inclusion. Respecting all backgrounds, differences and perspectives enables us to improve the lives of our people, customers, suppliers, contractors, and the communities in which we live and work. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity and/or expression, race, national origin, ethnicity, age, religion, marital status, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical condition, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
